mode.description: Collector output is attributed to parsed command clauses.

status_model.description: Execution-status attribution model used by this artifact.

telemetry_quality.description: Artifact-wide telemetry quality after loss, cleanup, and per-call checks.

collection_validity.description: Whether the artifact passed collector integrity validation.

state.description: Observed execution outcome for this clause.

exit_code.description: Process exit code when state is exited.

signal.description: Terminating signal number when state is signaled.

succeeded.description: Normalized success result, or null when no reliable result exists.

reason.description: Why execution status is missing, unavailable, or nonstandard.

source.description: Evidence source used to determine clause status.

bin.description: Normalized executable or shell builtin name.

argv.description: Parsed argument vector for the clause.

status.description: Clause execution outcome and its evidence source.

cpu_ns_cumulative.description: Cumulative CPU time for the clause in nanoseconds (the collector's raw key).

peak_cpu_cores.description: Maximum fixed-window CPU utilization in cores when eligible.

peak_memory_mb.description: Sampled process-lineage RSS peak in decimal megabytes.

network_rx_bytes.description: Attributed received bytes; currently null because clause network collection is not implemented.

network_tx_bytes.description: Attributed transmitted bytes; currently null because clause network collection is not implemented.

availability.description: Per-target availability reasons. Stable target keys are latency, cpu_time, cpu, memory, disk_io, and status; diagnostic details may expand.

bin.description: Parsed executable or builtin that produced no runtime exec image.

argv.description: Parsed arguments for the non-executed clause.

status.description: Evidence explaining why the clause did not execute.

peak_cpu_cores.description: Maximum CPU utilization in cores after summing all owned exec-image contributions in aligned 500 ms windows.

sampled_peak_rss_mb.description: Maximum sampled RSS in decimal megabytes after summing distinct live address spaces in aligned bins.

availability.description: Per-target availability of the call-level CPU and sampled RSS peaks, including reasons when unavailable.

cpu.description: ok or an unknown:<reason> value for the call-level CPU peak.

memory.description: ok or an unknown:<reason> value for the call-level RSS peak.

command.description: Original command associated with this telemetry record.

telemetry_quality.description: Quality of this call's mapping and measurements.

eligible_for_kb.description: Whether this complete call may contribute any KB observations; targets still apply their own eligibility checks.

call_resource.description: Call-level peak metrics reduced from aligned profiles across all mapped exec images.

no_runtime_exec.description: Parsed clauses proven not to have produced a runtime exec image.
